title: Hatsune Miku — Brand New Street〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I should've just waited patiently at the cafe. That said, there's no guarantee he would've stopped by.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm the one who wants to talk to him, so I should go look for him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hiya, Miku.
Are you headed to practice?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, I've been looking for you.
I have a favor to ask.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait, you want a favor from me?
It's not like you to seek me out like that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't tell me you actually have the utmost trust in me? Hahaha, you make me blush!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright, alright.
I want to discuss something, so settle down and hear me out.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like you to put together several tracks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't care if you use samples or anything, just make sure they're really hard to sing to.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane and the others are back on track to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This very moment, they're putting in the effort to make their dream a reality.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So I want to bring my skill level up too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course, I won't ask you to do this for nothing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What? You're gonna give me something...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I thought long and hard and decided on what I thought would be the most sincere gift idea.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It must be something real special!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Man, I was gonna do it anyway without a reward or anything. But if you're gonna give me something, then I guess I'll accept it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It really is special, so you won't be disappointed.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A batch of handmade cookies that go perfectly with coffee!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Whoa! Cookies?!
I'm stoked to try—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup. I'm gonna put my sweat, blood and tears into them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
W-Wait, Miku!
I'm really happy you'll do that for me, but—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: My kitchen skills just aren't up to your standards. That's why...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm making you a sandwich and a cupcake to go with your cookies.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait wait wait!
Why are you trying to make up for quality with quantity?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, even if I can only make something that's a three out of ten, three dishes will score a whole nine points.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But anyway, you've been getting better at cooking, so I don't think you'd actually score that low.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Even still, I'll pass on the reward this time. This is for Vivid BAD SQUAD after all.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I also want them to do their best, and I genuinely want to help you improve for their sake.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not to mention that this is a good challenge for me if you think about it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Coming up with a track that even you find difficult to sing isn't gonna be a walk in the park.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, let's consider that challenge my reward.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'll put those tracks together for you.
You won't be disappointed!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Even KAITO has his cool moments.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I wonder how those tracks will turn out.
I can't wait.
